leaf_hex: lowercase even hex, 0..16 bytes; empty permitted
proof: exactly 2 objects, keys side/hash; leaf upward order
side: sibling side: level j left iff index bit j is1, otherwise right; mismatched side refuses
hash: 64 lowercase hex characters -> raw32 digest bytes
tree: ordered complete 4-leaf, depth2, no sorting/padding/double SHA
trust: verifier-owned literal pinned before request, fixture assumption; no root distribution/authentication implemented
receiver: leaf bytes,index,two siblings,sender_root only; no baseline leaves used by verifier
duplicates: A at index0 and2 intentionally; accepted positional membership never unique value/person/provenance
classification: trusted_match iff folded root equals verifier pinned root; sender equality only internal consistency diagnostic
limits: no collision resistance proof or hash implementation certification
encoding and domain tags are ours, not NISTIR8202 protocol
